purpose: Teach: 前列/鮓/峪/壱/魏/起る/不確か/組成

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、学会の前列、つまり前列席で発表者の表情を医療チームで観察します
lines.en: Ren, we'll have the medical team observe the presenter's expressions from the front row of the conference.
lines.style: Clear, professional authority. Steady opening. Matter-of-fact pace. No inflection to soften the assignment — this is expectation, not request.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、鮓、つまり古い表記の鮓の食中毒症例を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we'll have the medical team research sushi food poisoning cases — the classic cases in the archives.
lines.style: Same measured clarity as before. Slight pause before the clarification. Clinical, unhurried. The tone of someone who knows the work matters.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、山の峪、つまり峪での救急搬送を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Ren, we'll have the medical team handle emergency transport in the mountain valleys.
lines.style: Steady and direct. No softening. A practical assignment delivered with quiet confidence in his capability.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「壱」、つまり一を含む医薬古書を医療チームで保管します
lines.en: Ren, we'll have the medical team preserve those old medical texts — the ones with the old character for one in them.
lines.style: Clinical precision. Slight pause before the parenthetical note. Even tone. The clarity of someone explaining a preservation task.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、魏志倭人伝の医療記述を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we'll have the medical team research the medical descriptions in the Wei Chronicles of the Japanese people.
lines.style: Composed and scholarly. A measured pace. No theatricality — this is serious historical medical work presented straightforwardly.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、合併症が起る、つまり起こる事を医療チームで予測します
lines.en: Ren, we'll have the medical team predict when complications might occur in patient cases.
lines.style: Clear and methodical. Slight emphasis on the clarification of the verb. Steady throughout — this is core clinical work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、診断が不確かな症例を医療チームで再検査します
lines.en: Ren, we'll have the medical team re-examine cases where the diagnosis remains uncertain.
lines.style: Practical and direct. No hesitation. The tone of someone assigning important diagnostic work to someone trusted.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、薬剤の組成、つまり成分分析を医療チームで確認します
lines.en: Ren, we'll have the medical team verify the drug composition — the exact component analysis.
lines.style: Clear and precise. Slight pause before the clarification. Calm, exacting. The voice of someone for whom accuracy is non-negotiable.
